end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation in humans and plants.
Yash gave examples of tissues and described tissue as similar cells doing the same job.
Ordered cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism correctly.
Discussed the difference between an organ, such as the heart, and an organ system, such as the circulatory system.
Teach-back was not passed by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Yash practised defining tissue, giving examples, and ordering the levels of organisation. They explained that the heart pumps blood and recognised that veins and arteries are also part of the circulatory system; the heart-versus-system mix-up was discussed but not fully confirmed as corrected in the final response. At home, ask them to explain one human and one plant example for each level using the sequence cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
